notes.title: Demo Coming Soon + Playtesters Wanted!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to share that the demo for The Endless Wyrd is launching in just a few weeks, so keep an eye on this space!

In the meantime, we’re looking for testers to help us fine-tune things during the demo release.
Want to be part of the testing crew? Join our Discord server and head to the announcements channel. There, just react to the tester message with a 🔍 magnifying glass emoji and you'll be given access to the tester channel.

[url=https://discord.gg/BhPx339V]Join our Discord here.[/url] 

[b]Quick dev update: [/b]
We’re currently in talks with a publisher, and development is back on track. Your feedback and support during the demo phase will have a real impact on what comes next for The Endless Wyrd. Every wishlist, comment and bug report helps us move forward.

Thanks for sticking with us. We’re so excited to share what we’ve been building.

Stay sane!

notes.title: The Endless Wyrd sways judges in a fierce pitch battle!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=tDDkoAWuXqo;full][/previewyoutube]
We are excited to announce that our dice deckbuilding roguelike adventure game, The Endless Wyrd, recently won the African leg of the [url=https://discovery-contest.nordicgame.com/]Nordic Game Discovery Contest[/url] (NGDC) Season V! NGDC is an exciting and competitive pitch competition, where indie developers have the opportunity to showcase their games to industry experts and convince the judges why their game deserves a chance to be discovered. Qualifiers are held globally throughout the year and finalists from around the world will then compete against each other in a final pitch battle in Sweden! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37554565/ade40f47d0565050c817c76f8c05f13150075a13.png[/img]

The first qualification round of the NGDC Season V took place during [url=https://gamesweek.africa/]Africa Games Week[/url] in Cape Town in early December 2020, where The Endless Wyrd, won the kick-off event for the 2021 season. But not without some bumps and bruises along the way – the competition was fierce! We were up against fantastic fellow African indie developers such as Sanaawavelab Media from Kenya, who presented an ambitious mashup, [url=https://zawadigames.com/]Zawadi Rally[/url], inspired by GTA and Euro Truck simulator in an authentic African setting. Dream Box from Zimbabwe showcased their innovative 2D action platformer,[url=http://dreambox.co.zw/download/xoli-and-the-world-of-tomorrow/] Xoli and the World of Tomorrow[/url], where you fend off the impending threat of COVID-19. The game is based on the principles of Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), a form of psychotherapy and a branch of clinical psychology. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37554565/7bcad10e2c9feef2ea4b725c2c050828762d3ab4.gif[/img]

In the end Design Imps swayed the judges in the final round and will be the first finalist to earn a seat for the NGDC Grand Finals. [i]"To us, The Endless Wyrd is the quest for the stupidly overpowered and we can't wait for players to uncover the ridiculously overpowered synergies and combinations that we have in store"[/i], says Janke van Jaarsveld, CEO and Lead Game Designer at Design Imps, [i]"We are also very proud of the game's South African roots, boasting the unique comic art style of Willem Samuel, who's band, SkreeAlleen, incidentally also lent their talents to the soundtrack.”[/i]

We are excited for players to be part of our journey - we will be launching a full demo of the game soon and the game is scheduled for an Early Access release in Q3 of 2021.[i] “At Design Imps we are committed to the concept of "Together we can make it better”. It was the reason we implemented an easy-to-use modding system for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/802400/Fhtagn__Tales_of_the_Creeping_Madness/]Fhtagn! - Tales of the Creeping Madness[/url] and the reason we want to have Early Access for The Endless Wyrd. We believe that with the input of players we can make this game amazing!”[/i], says Janke. 

Don’t miss out on the exciting developments and watch this space! Want to be part of the early access community? Consider joining our [url=https://discord.com/invite/XPVwgFT]Discord server[/url] and be sure to wishlist The Endless Wyrd on Steam. You can also play a sneak peek of the game (early alpha demo), available on our Steam storepage.

notes.title: A Sneak Peek into The Endless Wyrd
notes.content:
In this dice deck-building, roguelike adventure, scavenge the Wyrd and escape the approaching Thing of the Dark. Load your dice with powerful augments to create your own synergies and combos and stack the odds in your favour. In the rabbit hole of the Wyrd, the only way back up, is down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37554565/7bcad10e2c9feef2ea4b725c2c050828762d3ab4.gif[/img]

[h2]Sneak Peek Features[/h2]
Somehow in a freakish happenstance (or was it?!), you find yourself snatched into The Endless Wyrd, a strange realm ruled and hunted by the ever-lurking Thing in the Dark. Alone and defenceless, you scavenge the perilous domain for powerful items and fight the denizens of the Wyrd. With every battle you grow stronger and more powerful, but at a cost… with every step you take, Darkness is right behind you. 

In the sneak peek you will experience aspects of the following features and game mechanics: 
[list][*][b]Item synergies:[/b] Build up your deck with powerful items that synergise well together.
[*][b]Elemental synergies[/b]: Elemental effects can synergise e.g. Bleed damage is reduced by Cold and Disease can spread to Cold or Bleeding units.
[*][b]Interactives:[/b] Interact with the environment for new gameplay.
[*][b]Complex Boss mechanics:[/b] It’s like encountering a mini raid boss.
[*][b]Movement mechanics: [/b]Your character isn’t stuck in one place, which enables you to dodge certain attacks and most items have positional requirements.
[*][b]Manage your Scent: [/b]Strategically progress through the map, Darkness is right behind you.
[*][b]Unit synergies: [/b]Units gain new abilities and interactions when certain types of units are present.[/list]

[h2]Full Demo Coming Soon [/h2]
Please note that the sneak peek is not meant to be a full demo but provide a taste of gameplay mechanics and features. However, we will be releasing a full playable demo of the game soon and will launch on Early Access soon after. 

Game features that are not included in this sneak peek, but will be in the demo are:
[list][*][b]Dice and dice loading:[/b] With powerful augments, you can stack the odds in your favour and minimise the RNG.
[*][b]Upgrade items your way: [/b]Upgrade your items in any way that suits your style and deck.
[*][b]Enemies scale as you progress:[/b] Enemies gain new abilities and become stronger depending on what level you encounter them.
[*][b]Player-Unit synergies: [/b]The player can interact with certain units to get beneficial effects that affect combat, e.g. killing a specific unit causes damage to those around it.
[*][b]Use Sanity:[/b] Madness is a double-edged sword.
[*][b]More of everything:[/b] More artifacts, consumables, items and enemies! [/list]

[h2]Join Our Discord[/h2]
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/XPVwgFT]Discord Server[/url] - The community’s valuable feedback is an integral part in how development will roll out and the launch of major updates. We believe that with the input of players we can make this game amazing and we’d love for you to be part of this journey!

notes.title: The Endless Wyrd: Dev Livestream and Q&A
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37554565/7bcad10e2c9feef2ea4b725c2c050828762d3ab4.gif[/img]

Join us as we get sucked into the rabbit hole of the Wyrd and try to fight our way out of there! In this first look at our dice deck-building, roguelike adventure, we will explore current and future [b]features[/b] and [b]gameplay mechanics[/b]. 

During the stream you might also ponder questions like: 
[list]
[*] Do frogs really explode? 
[*] What does this button do? 
[*] How did that WW2 submarine get there? 
[*] What is THAT accent? 
[*] Where is South Africa and is it even a real country? 
[/list]

We will be happy to answer all these questions and more. 

[b]Don’t miss out - come hang out with us!  [/b]

In this dice-deck building, rogue-like adventure, scavenge the Wyrd and escape the approaching Thing of the Dark. Load your dice with powerful augments to create your own synergies and combos and stack the odds in your favour. In the rabbit hole of the Wyrd, the only way back up, is down.

In a couple of months, we will provide a playable demo of the game and will launch on Early Access soon after.
